verdict.rationale: Mollie's own Subscriptions API lets a user set a recurring schedule once, and Mollie then 'automatically create[s] recurring payments for you at the interval you specified', running in the background without customer interaction. That is a genuine user-configured, autonomous background process, but it is limited to recurring billing. Webhooks and the MCP server are building blocks or interactive tools, not autonomous automations, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automations or workflows beyond recurring payments, any agent-driven background task execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: The Subscriptions API provides an easy way to schedule recurring payments at regular intervals. When using this API, we automatically create recurring payments for you at the interval you specified.
Recurring payments happen in the background. The customer goes through the payment steps only once, for the first payment.
